label: Send eviction demand notice (grounds under Bihar Buildings Control Act s.11)
basis: Bihar Buildings (Lease, Rent & Eviction) Control Act, 1982 — eviction requires prior demand where the ground is non-payment of rent. AI-estimated; confirm exact procedural pre-requisite with reviewing advocate.

label: File Section 138 NI Act complaint (limitation: 1 month from cause of action)
basis: Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, s.142(b) — complaint must be made within one month of the date on which the cause of action arises (i.e., expiry of the 15-day notice period). AI-estimated from the chronology; lawyer must verify the exact cause-of-action date before relying on this.

label: Mandatory reporting / FIR registration window
basis: BNSS s.173 (successor to CrPC s.154) — FIR registration is mandatory without delay once a cognizable offence is disclosed (Lalita Kumari v. Govt. of U.P.). No independent limitation period for FIR registration itself; date shown flags urgency of immediate action, not a statutory deadline.
